hero.title: 研究与创作应用 Agent
hero.summary: 这个应用把深度研究和史诗写作两个场景模块组合到同一应用里，适合需要证据链和长期创作资产的任务。

taskTemplates.title: 整理知识产物
taskTemplates.goal: 输入主题、已有材料和目标读者，产出结构化知识资产或创作素材。
taskTemplates.description: 适合研究和创作之间的知识整理。
exampleTasks: 我有一批关于中国古代城市的资料，请整理成可继续写作的主题档案。
请把这些访谈记录整理成观点、案例和可引用片段，方便后续写报告。
我想围绕“长期主义”做一个知识专题，请帮我建立结构、关键问题和资料清单。
expectedOutputs: 知识档案：主题结构、关键概念、代表材料和适合继续扩展的方向。
素材索引：可引用片段、案例、人物、时间线和使用场景。
下一步产出建议：适合写成文章、报告、课程或创作设定的切入点。

taskTemplates.title: 把研究转成文章或报告
taskTemplates.goal: 输入研究材料、读者画像和表达目标，让应用组织论点并产出可修改的成稿。
taskTemplates.description: 适合把资料研究转成公众号文章、长文、内部报告或演讲稿。
exampleTasks: 请把我收集的资料写成一篇面向普通读者的长文，主题是 AI 如何改变知识工作。
我需要一份内部分享稿，解释某个行业变化对我们团队的影响。
帮我把零散笔记整理成一篇有观点、有例子、有结论的文章。
expectedOutputs: 文章结构：标题方向、核心论点、章节安排和每段要解决的问题。
成稿草案：面向指定读者的正文、案例穿插和结尾建议。
修改建议：事实待核查处、表达风险、可删减段落和增强说服力的方法。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 把研究材料转成可发布或可汇报的文本

taskTemplates.title: 沉淀创作设定库
taskTemplates.goal: 输入世界观、角色、时间线或资料来源，让应用整理成长期可复用的创作设定。
taskTemplates.description: 适合小说、剧本、游戏设定和长线内容创作。
exampleTasks: 我有一个近未来城市故事，请帮我整理世界观、主要势力和角色关系。
请把这些历史资料转成架空世界的设定素材，并标出哪些地方需要继续考证。
我的小说角色越来越多，请建立人物档案、关系图说明和时间线。
expectedOutputs: 设定库：世界规则、地点、势力、角色、关键事件和未定问题。
连续性检查：前后矛盾、缺失动机、时间线冲突和需要补写的设定。
创作推进建议：下一章可写事件、角色冲突和可使用的资料素材。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 建立可长期复用的创作设定资产

hero.title: Research & Creation Agent
hero.summary: This application combines deep-research and epic-writing scenarios in one package for work that needs both an evidence chain and durable creative assets.

taskTemplates.title: Organize a knowledge artifact
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the topic, existing materials, and target audience to produce a structured knowledge asset or creative source material.
taskTemplates.description: For organizing knowledge between research and creation.
exampleTasks: I have a batch of materials on ancient Chinese cities. Organize them into a thematic dossier that can support further writing.
Turn these interview records into viewpoints, cases, and quotable excerpts for a later report.
I want to create a knowledge topic around long-termism. Help build its structure, key questions, and source list.
expectedOutputs: Knowledge dossier: topic structure, key concepts, representative materials, and directions for expansion.
Source index: quotable excerpts, cases, people, timelines, and use contexts.
Next-output suggestions: angles suitable for an article, report, course, or creative setting.

taskTemplates.title: Turn research into an article or report
taskTemplates.goal: Provide research materials, audience profile, and communication goal so the application can organize the argument and produce an editable draft.
taskTemplates.description: For converting research into a public article, long-form piece, internal report, or talk.
exampleTasks: Turn my collected material into a long article for general readers about how AI changes knowledge work.
I need an internal presentation explaining how an industry change affects our team.
Turn scattered notes into an article with a viewpoint, examples, and conclusion.
expectedOutputs: Article structure: title directions, core argument, section plan, and the problem each section resolves.
Draft: body copy for the intended audience, integrated examples, and closing suggestions.
Revision advice: facts to verify, expression risks, removable passages, and ways to strengthen persuasion.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Turn research material into a publishable or presentable text

taskTemplates.title: Build a creative world bible
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the world setting, characters, timeline, or source materials so the application can organize durable creative references.
taskTemplates.description: For novels, screenplays, game settings, and long-running content creation.
exampleTasks: I have a near-future city story. Help organize its world rules, major factions, and character relationships.
Turn these historical sources into material for an alternate-world setting and flag what needs more research.
My novel has too many characters. Build character profiles, relationship notes, and a timeline.
expectedOutputs: World bible: rules, locations, factions, characters, key events, and unresolved questions.
Continuity review: contradictions, missing motivations, timeline conflicts, and settings that need expansion.
Writing-next suggestions: events for the next chapter, character conflicts, and source material to use.
